phases.name: Discovery, process validation & solution foundation
phases.scope: Validate legal entities, GST registrations, warehouse mapping, accounting policy, textile attributes, approval matrix, opening balances, integrations and exception scenarios. Freeze requirements and data dictionary.
phases.exit: Signed process maps; solution architecture; role-permission matrix; data model; integration inventory; Figma design system; phase acceptance plan.

phases.name: Core masters, security, organisation & platform foundation
phases.scope: Legal entities, GST registrations, branches, warehouses, locations, users, roles, permissions, audit logs, master data, document storage, notification framework, configuration and admin controls.
phases.exit: Users can securely operate the system with correct entity/GSTIN/warehouse scope; master data and audit trails work; no hard-coded warehouse or GST assumptions.

phases.name: Purchase, supplier management & AI invoice capture
phases.scope: Supplier lifecycle, RFQ, purchase requisition/PO, supplier confirmations, direct-to-mill purchase flow, invoice capture, three-way matching, missing invoice control, AP postings and supplier intelligence.
phases.exit: PO-to-receipt-to-invoice reconciliation demonstrated, including missing/late invoice, duplicate invoice and discrepancy exception paths.

phases.name: Mill processing / job-work management
phases.scope: Mill master, job-work orders/challans, outward material, mill portal, stage tracking, rate engine, return receipt, yield/loss, quality disputes, due-date and statutory tracking.
phases.exit: Complete job-work cycle reconciles sent, received, processed, rejected, balance and cost; stock at mill remains visible and owned by trader.

phases.name: Inventory, barcode, warehouse management & transfers
phases.scope: Lot and roll barcodes, receiving/QC, pricing tags, WMS locations, stock ledger, reservations, stocktaking, ageing, warehouse transfers, separate-GSTIN transfer documentation and stock intelligence.
phases.exit: Every KG/roll is traceable; stock derives from immutable movements; barcode scans prevent duplicate picks; transfers reconcile source and destination.

phases.name: CRM, sales team, quotation & commercial controls
phases.scope: Dynamic lead sources, lead allocation, attendance-aware round robin, CRM 360, follow-ups, quotations, negotiation, customer credit approval, pricing approvals, staff activity and sales analytics.
phases.exit: Lead-to-order traceability and commercial approval controls demonstrated; absent employees are skipped in allocation.

phases.name: B2B customer website, booking, payment & customer portal
phases.scope: Catalogue, fabric search, customer registration, cart, token booking, ICICI gateway, customer-specific rules, credit/advance, order tracking, invoices, wallet/advance ledger and customer-side approvals.
phases.exit: Token is calculated on configured taxable value excluding GST; payment is server-verified; stock reservation is atomic and duplicate booking is prevented.

phases.name: Order orchestration, allocation, dispatch & transport
phases.scope: Warehouse priority engine, Surat-first default, allocation scoring, manual override, management-approved split fulfilment, payment/invoice dispatch gates, pick/pack, transport, tracking and POD.
phases.exit: One-warehouse and approved multi-warehouse fulfilment pass end-to-end; GST registration-wise documentation is correct; all overrides are audited.

phases.name: Accounting, GST, TDS & financial control
phases.scope: Full double-entry accounting, chart of accounts, GL, AP/AR, receipts/payments, bank reconciliation, inventory valuation, GST, TDS, statutory reports, financial statements, period close and anomaly alerts.
phases.exit: Trial balance balances; source transactions post correctly; entity/GSTIN books and consolidated management reports reconcile; CA signs off tax configurations.

phases.name: Communications, workflow automation, DMS & HRMS
phases.scope: WhatsApp/SMS/email templates, trigger engine, approvals, tasks, escalations, document management, contracts, HR, attendance, leave, payroll and employee handover.
phases.exit: Key events generate correct communications/tasks; failed notifications retry; HR/payroll postings reconcile to accounting.

phases.name: BI, AI intelligence, advanced optimisation & continuity
phases.scope: Dynamic reports, dashboards, AI copilot, document reconciliation, procurement/stock/customer/commercial/financial intelligence, predictive alerts, offline mobile support, DR and advanced optimisation.
phases.exit: AI suggestions are explainable and approval-controlled; reports respect permissions; backup restoration and continuity tests pass.

phases.name: UAT, migration, training, go-live & stabilisation
phases.scope: Master/opening balance migration, data cleansing, UAT, performance/security testing, training, cutover, hypercare, monitoring and release sign-off.
phases.exit: Business owners sign UAT; opening balances reconcile; go-live checklist complete; rollback and support plan approved.

requirements.detail: Document current and target processes including direct-to-mill purchase, late supplier invoices, mill returns, stock transfers, split dispatch, credit sales, returns and GSTIN-specific flows.
Capture legal entity, PAN, GSTIN, state, registration type, place-of-business and mapping of each warehouse; do not assume one legal entity or one GSTIN.
Obtain CA-approved inventory valuation (FIFO/weighted average), revenue/advance treatment, job-work compliance, inter-GSTIN transfers, TDS sections and period-close rules.
Agree configurable attributes by fabric type: knit type, composition, GSM, width, open/tubular, colour, design, finish, shade/dye lot, shrinkage, fastness, pilling, quality grade and tolerances.
Define who approves price/discount, below-margin sales, credit, customer bank changes, supplier bank changes, stock adjustments, split dispatch, dispatch override, journals, refunds and write-offs.
Define source files, opening stock by warehouse/GSTIN/lot/roll, open PO/job-work/order, AR/AP, advances, bank, GST and ledger opening balances.

requirements.feature: Legal entity / GST registration / branch / warehouse
requirements.detail: Maintain separate records and relationships. One legal entity may have multiple GST registrations; multiple warehouses may map to a registration. Support future additions without code changes.
Permissions by module, screen, action, field, entity, GSTIN, branch, warehouse, value threshold and record ownership; include maker-checker.
Record actor, timestamp, before/after values, reason, source, approver and device/session for sensitive changes; posted vouchers and stock movements cannot be silently deleted.
Customer, supplier, manufacturer, mill, transporter, employee, product, fabric specification, UOM, HSN/tax, price lists, payment terms, bank, reason codes and document types.
Configurable numbering, fiscal year, tax rules, approval workflows, notification templates, warehouse priority, token policy, credit policy and feature toggles.
Secure uploads, versioning, metadata, entity linking, access rules, retention and preview for PDF/images/spreadsheets.
GSTIN/PAN, bank verification, contacts, categories, terms, historical prices, delivery, quality, documentation, disputes, ratings and risk score.
Create RFQ, invite multiple suppliers, receive quotes through portal/upload, compare landed cost, terms, lead time and quality; convert selected quote to PO.
Create, approve, revise and send PO; supplier acceptance, quantity/date confirmation, dispatch details and document upload.

requirements.feature: Purchase material sent directly to mill
requirements.detail: Link PO and supplier dispatch to mill receipt/job-work; material ownership and source documents remain traceable even when trader warehouse never physically receives grey fabric.

Support PDFs, images, scans, multipage files and batch upload; extract GSTIN, invoice no/date, PO, items, HSN, quantity, rate, taxable value, tax and total; target 100–150 invoices/hour to be performance-tested, not guaranteed.
Match supplier invoice against PO and mill receipt; detect duplicate invoice number/GSTIN/value, late/missing invoice, quantity/rate mismatch and unresolved documents; alerts and escalations.
Show source document beside extracted fields, field confidence, corrections, exception reason and reviewer approval; never auto-post an invoice without human approval.
Approved invoice posts to supplier ledger/AP; retain links to PO, goods receipt, job-work and supporting docs; payment approval and due-date tracking.
GSTIN, location, processes, capacity, rates, TAT, credit terms, contacts, performance and documents.
Record source PO, SKU, lot/roll, KG, mill, process, rate basis, dispatch/receipt dates, expected return, transport and documents.
Mill confirms receipt quantity, discrepancies, stage, completion, ready-for-collection, invoice and dispute; portal confirmation is authoritative, not an unverified chat.
Inspection, pretreatment, dyeing, washing, finishing, compacting, final QC and packing; stages configurable by process.
Support per-KG, fixed, per-process, mill/product-specific, slabs, negotiated rates, effective dates and rate history.
Track KG sent, received, processed, good output, rejected/damaged, balance, wastage, yield %, cost and reason.
Maintain separate expected return date, internal overdue date and statutory job-work deadline; alerts before due date and escalations after; CA validates statutory rules.
Record defects, samples, photos, quantity affected, root cause, debit/credit claim, responsibility and closure.
Each SKU has lots/batches; each lot contains individual rolls. Lot barcode and roll barcode supported; partial dispatch selects rolls without double deduction.
Receive from mill/supplier/transfer, weigh, scan, inspect, grade A/B/C/reject, record shade/GSM/width/weight and putaway.
At processed return/inward, assign selling price per KG at lot/roll level as configured; price changes require approval and history.
Derive balances from stock movements; never rely on manual global stock overwrite. Track physical, available, reserved, allocated, in-transit, at-mill, hold, damaged and returned.
Zones, aisles, racks, bins, receiving, QC, staging and damaged areas; putaway, directed picking, batch/zone picking and cycle counts.
Request, approve, issue correct GST documents, scan dispatch, record LR/transporter, in-transit, destination receipt, discrepancy and closure.

Treat transfer between distinct GST registrations as a tax-sensitive transaction; generate appropriate invoice/document and accounting per CA-approved configuration; do not treat as a simple stock adjustment.
Barcode/rack/roll stock count, variance report, reason, maker-checker approval and stock ledger adjustment.
Maintain shade/dye lot grouping; warn/block unintended shade mixing, apply customer shade acceptance and track shade-related claims.
Ageing buckets 0–30, 31–60, 61–90, 91–180, 181–365 and >365 days; dead/slow stock and clearance recommendation.
Capture Meta, IndiaMART, Justdial, website, WhatsApp, phone, email, referral, exhibition, trade platform and manual leads; future sources addable by admin using API/webhook/CSV mapping.
Detect by mobile, email and GSTIN; allow merge, link, keep separate or escalate with audit; no silent deletion.
Allocate by city, state, product, source, value, language, specialization and workload; allow specific assignment and reassignment history.
Skip absent, on leave, weekly off, break, inactive or unavailable employees; enforce configurable max active leads.
New, assigned, contact pending, contacted, qualified, quotation, negotiation, order confirmed, won/lost/nurture; no open lead without next follow-up or reason.
Enquiries, quotes, orders, purchases, fabric preferences, prices, payment/outstanding, complaints, communications, dispatch, salesperson and customer value.
Versioned quotations, validity, fabric/lot, KG, price, taxes, freight, terms, negotiation history, competitor price and lost reason.

Price can vary by customer, quantity, lot/roll and salesperson authority; preserve list price, requested price, discount, cost, margin, approver and reason; block below-minimum margin without approval.
Support advance and approved credit; credit limit, outstanding, ageing, exposure, block/override, terms and approval.
Leads, response time, qualified leads, quotes, KG, revenue, margin, new/repeat customers and collections; incentive eligibility based on verified outcomes.
Approved stock only; images, specifications, filters, available KG, MOQ, price/KG where permitted, shade/lot details and availability status.
GSTIN, company profile, addresses, multiple contacts and roles: company admin, purchase manager, buyer, accounts and management.
KG-based ordering, stock validation, customer-specific terms, saved/repeat orders, order approval where configured.

Token % or fixed amount as permitted, configurable at global/category/product/customer/campaign level with min/max, validity, refund/cancellation and approval. User policy: % of taxable bill value excluding GST; CA to validate advance GST treatment.
Server-side verification, signed webhook, idempotency, UTR/reference, payment status, refund/partial refund where supported, reconciliation and secure expiring payment links.
On confirmed booking/payment, reserve stock atomically; prevent race conditions/double booking; expiry, extension approval, release and partial cancellation.
Track orders, token/balance, invoices, receipts, dispatch, LR, tracking, POD, payment history, support and complaints.
Track customer advance and adjustments with correct accounting/tax treatment; distinguish wallet balance from revenue.
Default Surat-first; if insufficient, recommend configured next warehouse based on stock, quality, customer location, freight/ETA, GSTIN and workload; configurable priority.
Authorized users can override recommendation with mandatory reason; retain recommended option, selected option, user, approver and timestamp.
If one warehouse cannot fulfil, show shortage and alternatives; do not auto-split. Multiple warehouses require management approval and separate fulfilment records.
Default dispatch hold until GST invoice generated and payment receipt verified; approved customer credit terms count as authorized terms. Authorized override requires reason, approver and audit.
Generate pick list, scan selected roll barcodes, prevent reserved/dispatched duplicates, verify KG/weight, packing, loading and dispatch.
Transporter master, FTL/PTL, routes, vehicle/driver, freight comparison, LR/docket, e-way bill where applicable, manual milestones and live GPS if API available.
Customer notices, tracking link, ePOD, delivery confirmation, short delivery, transit damage, transport claims and closure.
Return request, authorization, inward, QC disposition, restock/hold/reject, replacement, refund or credit note with source traceability.
Build the application as primary accounting system: chart of accounts, GL, journals, vouchers, trial balance, period locks and audit.

requirements.feature: AP, AR, customer and supplier ledgers
requirements.detail: Automatic posting from approved purchase, sales, receipts, payments, credit/debit notes, expenses, payroll and stock transactions.
Separate books, invoice series, ledgers and tax balances by legal entity/GST registration; consolidated management reporting and intercompany elimination where relevant.
CA-approved FIFO or weighted average; include purchase, processing, freight and other landed costs; support lot/roll profitability.
CGST/SGST/IGST, HSN, place of supply, RCM where applicable, ITC, output tax, e-invoice/IRN, e-way bill, GSTR-1/3B preparation, GSTR-2B/IMS reconciliation.
Configurable sections, rates, thresholds, PAN, effective dates, deductions, challans, returns and reconciliation.
Import statements, match receipts/payments, handle unmatched and duplicate lines, track UTR and approval.
P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, trial balance, customer/supplier ageing, cash/bank, working capital, inventory days, DSO/DPO and financial year close.
Flag duplicate supplier payments, bank detail changes, unusual discounts, credit notes, refunds, journals and unexpected ledger movements.
Templates and triggers for enquiry, quote, booking, invoice, payment reminder/link, receipt, dispatch, LR, tracking, POD, feedback and complaint.
Language, variables, approval, active status, consent, WhatsApp template compliance, delivery/read/failure status and retry.
Trigger, conditions, actions, approval, delay, reminder, escalation and completion; task has source transaction, owner, priority, due date and resolution.
Unified tasks, follow-ups, approvals, due/overdue, handover and reassignment.
Supplier/mill/customer contracts, rates, validity, payment/quality/delivery terms, penalties, renewal alerts 30/15/7 days, correspondence and AI search.
Recruitment, onboarding, probation, confirmation, transfer, resignation, exit, documents, shifts, GPS/biometric optional, leave, weekly off, overtime and comp-off.
Salary components, PF, ESIC, PT, salary TDS, payslips, disbursement and accounting posting; validate rules with payroll/CA experts.
Transfer open leads, tasks, approvals, customer commitments and documents on leave/exit; audit ownership transfer.
Choose module/entity/fields, filters, AND/OR, group, sort, aggregate, date, warehouse, employee, customer, supplier and product; save, schedule, email and export Excel/CSV/PDF.

Owner control tower, supplier performance, purchase planning, fabric quality, mill processing, inventory ageing, customer retention, negotiation, transport/freight, credit risk, GST, AI exceptions and employee productivity.
Recommend supplier based on price, quality, lead time, capacity, reliability and risk; draft RFQs; approval before PO.
Compare GSM/width/composition/finish/quality and shade; tolerance checks, compatible substitute suggestions and customer acceptance.
Stock health score, transfer recommendation, reservation priority, ageing action, discrepancy anomaly and demand-based replenishment.
Buying cycle, repeat purchase alerts, customer profitability/score, churn risk and credit exposure; explain source factors.
Quote conversion, price elasticity, negotiation simulator, competitor price register and follow-up prioritisation.
Show funds blocked in stock, mills, unbilled receipts, AR and advances; calculate order margin after freight, processing, discount, commission and returns.
Natural-language questions, daily management brief, multi-document reconciliation, anomaly explanations and voice interface; all consequential actions require user confirmation/approval.
Allow safe offline capture where appropriate; server validates financial/dispatch release. Backups, restore tests, RTO/RPO, monitoring and continuity runbook.
Import, validate, reconcile and sign off masters, stock, AR/AP, advances, bank, GST, open POs, job-work, orders and ledgers.
Test normal, exception, permission, concurrency, tax, barcode, integration, performance, security, backup and restore scenarios.
Admin, purchase, stores, mill operations, sales, accounts, dispatch, management, customer and partner portals.
Freeze legacy data, final migration, reconciliation, go/no-go, rollback, support ownership, incident severity and stabilisation.

Supplier PO response and dispatch update
